title: The pricing page gives the Free plan two different limits
line: The plan card says daily limits. The FAQ on the same page says weekly. The suggested string leaves the period to the team.

title: API Portal and API Console name the same dashboard
line: Both names link to the same console, and no page uses both.

title: Sonar is retired, but the Audit API pages still mention it
line: Sonar support ended in September 2026. The Audit API pages still say "Sonar API keys".

title: Help disagrees on whether Pro Search can be turned on
line: One article says Pro Search is automatic, with "nothing to turn on". Another says "turn on Pro Search".

title: "Disabled" describes settings, accounts and buttons
line: On the firewall page it describes two toggles with opposite results.

title: Organization settings is written two ways
line: "Organization Settings" and "Organization settings" both appear, and three pages use both.

title: The Comet data deletion article still says Spaces
line: Spaces became Projects, but this article wasn't updated.

title: A saved conversation is a session in Help and a thread in the docs
line: The help article's URL also still says thread.

title: The admin role has four names
line: Help says organization admin, Enterprise admin and organization administrator. The docs mostly say org admin. The roles page says Admin.

title: One cookbook page says API Group instead of Project
line: It also says API Group administrator. Other docs pages say Project and Project administrator.

title: The audit key has two names
line: Docs say "audit log API key". Help says "Audit API key". Each has its own heading about creating one.

title: One help sentence uses both sidecar and Assistant panel
line: "Send to sidecar to continue the conversation in your Assistant panel."

title: The setting that adds credits automatically has four names
line: Auto reload, auto top-up, Automatic Top Up or auto_recharge, depending on the page.

title: Two help articles call the Free plan Standard
line: The pricing page says Free. The help articles say "Free (Standard) plan".
